capabilities: create citation links that open a note at the exact cited passage
preview the cited passage on hover
check a note for broken or changed citations
copy a note without citation links for pasting into a word processor
insert APA 7 reference lists and align in-text citations in English or French
disambiguation: Not a reference manager for external bibliographies; it cites notes already in the vault, not works stored in a citation database.
extras: Not yet in the community plugin directory: manual installation from a release is required. Desktop only, needs Obsidian 1.13.7+. Makes no network requests and no citation links appear in graph view or backlinks.
problem: Obsidian's internal links point to whole notes only, so academic writing cannot cite a specific passage of a note or generate APA-formatted references from what a note cites.

relations.evidence: With Literature Graph, the citation links also become the edges of a graph of your literature

summary: Citation plugin that links a citation to the exact passage of a vault note, with hover previews, citation checking, and APA 7 reference lists.
